contents.text: The Comparison page puts louis-agent beside Semantic Kernel, and it also covers Microsoft Agent Framework. Each cell says where its claim comes from.

arguments.question: What would you like to do next?

choices.why: I'll walk through what the page says for it.

choices.why: Tools an agent can use, in a package of their own.

choices.label: Show me how to build my own agent
choices.why: The guides for an identity, a pack and a site.
